purpose: Measure observable market leadership, handoffs, persistence, competition, and minute-to-minute candidate change without deciding whether to trade.

source_scanner.rank_scope: full identity-resolved membership with a completed close and prior close
source_scanner.candidate_row_scope: market-qualified candidates from activation through the exclusive scanner cutoff

feature_definitions.name: active_market_candidate_count
feature_definitions.meaning: Count of upstream market-qualified candidates active at the decision minute; it is not a count of every moving stock.

feature_definitions.name: active_candidates_with_better_market_rank
feature_definitions.meaning: Number of active upstream candidates whose full-membership gain rank is better than this candidate's rank.

feature_definitions.name: market_leader_symbol
feature_definitions.meaning: Full-membership percentage-gain leader observable at the decision minute.

feature_definitions.name: market_leader_percent_gain
feature_definitions.meaning: Percentage gain of the full-membership leader at the decision minute.

feature_definitions.name: prior_observed_market_leader_symbol
feature_definitions.meaning: Leader from the immediately preceding minute, or null across an observation gap.

feature_definitions.name: market_leader_changed_from_prior_minute
feature_definitions.meaning: Whether full-membership leadership changed since the immediately preceding observed minute.

feature_definitions.name: observed_market_leader_tenure_minutes
feature_definitions.meaning: Consecutive observed minutes held by the same market leader; resets across gaps.

feature_definitions.name: candidate_top_gainer_rank
feature_definitions.meaning: Candidate's full-membership percentage-gain rank from the source scanner.

feature_definitions.name: candidate_is_market_leader
feature_definitions.meaning: Whether the candidate is rank one and agrees with the full-membership leader symbol.

feature_definitions.name: candidate_became_market_leader_this_minute
feature_definitions.meaning: Whether the candidate replaced a different observed leader during this exact minute.

feature_definitions.name: candidate_consecutive_market_leader_minutes
feature_definitions.meaning: Consecutive candidate observations at rank one; zero when the candidate is not leader.

feature_definitions.name: candidate_rank_improvement_from_prior_minute
feature_definitions.meaning: Prior rank minus current rank, so a positive number means rank improved; null across missing minutes.

feature_definitions.name: candidate_percent_gain
feature_definitions.meaning: Candidate gain from the exact completed source bar; null when that exact bar is missing.

feature_definitions.name: candidate_gain_change_pct_points_from_prior_minute
feature_definitions.meaning: One-minute change in exact-bar percentage gain; null when either exact bar is missing.

feature_definitions.name: candidate_gap_to_leader_pct_points
feature_definitions.meaning: Leader gain minus exact candidate gain in percentage points; null without an exact candidate bar.

feature_definitions.name: candidate_gap_change_pct_points_from_prior_minute
feature_definitions.meaning: One-minute change in the candidate's gap to the leader; a negative number means the gap narrowed.

feature_definitions.name: candidate_cumulative_volume
feature_definitions.meaning: Candidate cumulative volume from the exact completed source bar.

feature_definitions.name: candidate_volume_change_from_prior_minute
feature_definitions.meaning: One-minute increase in candidate cumulative volume; null when either exact bar is missing.

feature_definitions.name: minutes_since_candidate_activation
feature_definitions.meaning: Whole minutes elapsed since causal upstream market qualification.

explicit_nonfeatures: no retrospective Ross entry or fill
no later high, outcome, trade, or P&L
no claim that gain rank equals human attention
interpretation_limit: These are transparent market-state proxies. They do not observe Ross Cameron's watchlist, chat room, Level 2, tape, proprietary scanner, or other traders' focus, so they cannot by themselves reproduce discretionary attention.
